# Kelowna Protech Elite Mobile Mechanic

> Mobile diagnostic specialist in Kelowna, BC, Canada. A certified mechanic comes to the vehicle and finds what actually failed, in front of the client — no tow truck, no shop drop-off, same-day in most cases.

Last verified: 2026-08-15.

## Who We Are

Kelowna Protech Elite Mobile Mechanic is a mobile-only automotive service led by a certified mechanic. The specialty is advanced diagnostics: finding the actual cause of a fault, including automotive electrical and electronic problems, rather than replacing parts until the symptom disappears.

We go to the client, at their home, workplace, or roadside. We diagnose the problem on-site, source the parts ourselves, and complete the repair the same day in most cases. The client hands over the keys and we handle the rest, with the work happening in their own driveway where they can watch it.

Rated 4.9 stars on Google with 65 verified reviews (confirmed 2026-08-13 via Google Business Profile).

## How We Work

- The client only hands over the keys. We handle the diagnosis, the parts logistics, and the repair.
- The work happens in the client's driveway, workplace parking lot, or wherever the vehicle already is, in full view of the client.
- We take a limited number of vehicles per day so no repair is rushed.
- First contact is by text message, so the schedule and the agreed scope stay written down for the client.

## Pre-Purchase Car Inspection (our specialty)

A mobile pre-purchase car inspection performed at the seller's driveway or dealer lot, anywhere in our service area — the buyer never has to move an unknown vehicle.

- 100+ individual checks across 10 systems, ranked by financial risk: engine and live data scan, transmission, frame and body, brakes, suspension, differential (4x4/AWD), fluids and leaks, tires, road test, and a photo-rich report.
- Dealer-level diagnostic scan: live data, freeze frames, stored and pending fault codes.
- Report delivered on-site the same day, with photos of every finding, repair suggestions, estimated repair costs, and a negotiation-ready summary on request.
- All model years accepted for inspections — recent documented inspections range from a 1990 Ford F-150 to late-model vehicles.
- Same-day booking is often possible.

Details: https://kelownaprotechmobilemech.com/services/pre-purchase/

## Advanced Diagnostics (our core specialty)

A mobile diagnostic is a private service. One client at a time, at their own home, with the vehicle where it already sits. The client watches the work from their sofa with a coffee instead of arranging a ride and waiting for a call.

Because the work happens in front of them, the client can step outside at any point and ask the mechanic what he is doing and why, and get the answer on the spot. When the diagnosis is finished, the mechanic shows them the failed component on their own vehicle and explains what it means and what it affects. Nothing about the diagnosis is taken on faith, because the client saw it.

That is also what keeps the bill predictable. Before anything is taken apart, the client is told what failed and what the repair will cost, and that is the figure they pay. If the scope needs to change, it is approved by the client first, not explained afterward.

Same-day diagnosis at the client's home or workplace is possible in most cases, and when the parts are available the repair is completed in the same visit. This suits clients who value their time, want to understand what they are paying for, and prefer the work to happen at their own door.

We diagnose automotive electrical and electronic faults, including intermittent problems other shops could not isolate; no-start conditions across the battery, starter, alternator and charging system; diesel systems; and commercial fleet vehicles.

Details: https://kelownaprotechmobilemech.com/services/diagnostic/

Repairs focus on 2010-and-newer vehicles. All makes and models including European vehicles. Pre-purchase inspections accept all model years.

Also available anywhere in the Okanagan Valley (including further south, e.g. Osoyoos) for a distance-based travel fee — contact to confirm before booking outside the primary area.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Answers below reflect the FAQ schema published on the pre-purchase inspection page.

**How much can I lose if I skip a pre-purchase inspection?**
A hidden engine or transmission problem on a used vehicle can run $3,000 to $10,000 or more to fix once you already own the car, since major mechanical failures are exactly what a seller's clean CarFax and visual walk-around won't show you. A pre-purchase inspection is often less than 1% of the car's price and takes about an hour, before you own the problem.

**Do I have to bring the car in, or does the mechanic come to me?**
The mechanic comes to you. That is the whole point of a mobile pre-purchase inspection: the buyer never tows or drives an unknown vehicle anywhere before it has been checked. Inspections happen at the seller's driveway, the dealer lot, or wherever the vehicle currently is.

**How fast can an inspection or diagnostic be scheduled?**
Same-day is often possible in Kelowna and the surrounding Okanagan Valley. There is no shop queue to wait behind since the work happens wherever the vehicle already is.

## Why Clients Choose Us

Clients pay for certainty, speed, and convenience — not the cheapest price. A mobile diagnosis eliminates the cost and hassle of towing, and catches problems before they become more expensive. Most clients are back on the road the same day.

Common client profiles: a Kelowna resident whose vehicle won't start or has a warning light and needs it resolved without disrupting their day, or a used-car buyer who wants the vehicle independently inspected at the seller's location before paying.
